subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “'Now it has carried two people into a new part of life,' he said.”?
options: Sometimes it means choosing which parts must remain and which parts must change so a place can live again.
Leo did not fully understand the sentence, but he knew the bike would not be left behind the tree again.
The grandchildren wrote down what they learned, but they also knew that the real recipe had lived in Grandma's hands.
If people want future readers to understand today's online world, someone must save it before links break and pages vanish.
